excerpt: This week's key economic data includes the Federal Reserve's June meeting minutes and various housing and manufacturing reports. The minutes will provide insights into potential interest rate changes. Housing market indicators and manufacturing PMI are also notable releases.

# July 2024 Economic Calendar - Mortgage Elements. ## Mortgage Economic Calendar for July 2024. Below is the Mortgage Economic Calendar that shows when key Economic Indicators and Economic Data is scheduled for release in July 2024. Since this is a website for the Mortgage Industry, this Mortgage Economic Calendar emphasizes Economic Data that is of particular interest to Housing, Real Estate, and Mortgage Professionals. The last two pages contain a brief description of the major Economic Indicators that are included in this Economic Calendar. As an additional service, we prepare a Mortgage Economic Review each month that summarizes Economic Data and events that are important to Mortgage and Real Estate Professionals. The Mortgage Economic Review can be read on our **blog**, or emailed to you at the beginning of each month. To download a PDF of the Mortgage Economic Calendar for July 2024 – Click on the calendar below.
